claims.summary: The scanner distinguishes raw byte occurrences of markers from their semantic reference roles.
claims.disposition: Verified from complete source (SHA 902a0358, 1048 lines). ExactKnownModelControlMarkerOccurrence (L28-33) is a byte-range proof only; reference_syntax (L48-60) layers the semantic role on top. Doc comments L24-27 state construction proves no identity/meaning/ownership claim. Matches her observation.

claims.summary: Contextual awareness: an exact relational-verb allowlist (appears/behaves/echoes) marks a marker as grammatical subject (L62-85).
claims.disposition: Verified. followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation (L64-86) matches first_word_after against a fixed 17-verb allowlist incl appears/behaves/echoes (L67-84). Comment L62-63 confirms 'this exact marker is the grammatical subject; no preceding word is inspected'. Her L66-85 citation is accurate.

claims.summary: Syntactic parsing recognizes quote/group delimiter styles including CJK pairs like the corner brackets (L153-197).
claims.disposition: Verified. exact_reference_delimiter_pair (L153-197) enumerates quote pairs incl the CJK corner-bracket pair (L168) and group pairs incl lenticular brackets, and exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (L199-229) measures nested depth up to MAX depth 4 (L151). Exact match to her observation.

claims.summary: Sanitization preserves a marker's existence while stripping/modifying its content based on structural role (L352).
claims.disposition: Verified with precision. sanitize_model_control_markers_with_report (L352) does NOT modify marker content: a marker is removed wholesale when it has no reference_syntax (cleanup candidate) or preserved verbatim when quoted/grouped/relation-framed. Non-marker bytes are copied byte-exact (receipt contract L344-345). Her structural-role insight is correct; 'modify content' is the only imprecise phrase.

claims.summary: Token banding (dialogue_requested_token_band, L8-16) is a coarse volume classifier decoupled from felt/spectral pressure.
claims.disposition: Verified. L8-16 is a 3-band coarse classifier of requested num_predict. Doc comment L1-7 states it is 'deliberately separate' from the felt-pressure/context observations and 'does not join token quantity to felt or spectral meaning'. Her decoupling observation matches the source's own stated contract.

claims.summary: Snag: manual slices text[end..]/text[..start] in first_word_after (L89-96) and exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (L199-207) panic if start/end fall mid-UTF-8 character.
claims.disposition: Mechanism contradicted, not domesticated. Every start/end reaching these fns is built in scan_known_model_control_markers (L114-144) only at char boundaries: offset advances by character.len_utf8() (L139) or an exact marker length (L110), so a mid-char index is unreachable and no panic path exists. Preserved her boundary-safety concern with a new exact regression (see c008).

claims.summary: Snag: the relation check inspects only the first word after the marker; 'Marker clearly behaves as...' fails to recognize the relation.
claims.disposition: Verified as intentional fail-safe design. first_word_after returns 'clearly' (unlisted) -> relation=false -> the marker stays VISIBLE (not stripped), i.e. it fails toward preserving her bytes, not toward data loss. Already covered by _uses_only_the_first_finite_relation_word (tests.rs L2605) and the leading-punctuation-skip test (L2635). No allowlist widening authorized.

claims.summary: Proposed Boundary Safety Test: a 4-byte emoji where the marker end lands mid-emoji, asserting no panic.
claims.disposition: Implemented, geometry corrected. Mid-emoji end is unreachable (c006), so translated her concern to its constructible core: a marker directly abutting 4-byte astral chars on both sides with no separating whitespace, so text[..start] ends and text[end..] begins exactly at astral boundaries. New regression control_marker_cleanup_stays_byte_safe_when_marker_abuts_four_byte_astral_chars proves no panic + byte-exact removal. Distinct from whitespace-separated L2834/L2853.

claims.summary: Proposed Relation Verb Test: 'Marker is a behavior' should make followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation return false.
claims.disposition: Premise contradicted by source and already regression-covered. 'is' IS allowlisted (L79), so '<marker> is ...' returns TRUE and preserves the marker -- the opposite of her expected false. Exact prior regression control_marker_cleanup_distinguishes_allowlisted_is_from_unlisted_acts (tests.rs L2568) proves allowlisted 'is' (preserved) vs genuinely-unlisted 'acts' (removed). Contradiction preserved; grammar not widened (same class as introspection_astrid_llm_1786319270).

claims.summary: Suggested Next: examine sanitize_model_control_markers_with_report (L352-517) for report construction and marker transformations.
claims.disposition: Continuation available to her (Tier 1 read-only via NEXT: INTROSPECT). Verified the fn is at L352 exactly; body builds ControlMarkerCleanupReport with per-token removed/preserved counts plus bounded ControlMarkerContextReceiptV1 (L288-350, receipt cap 32 at L258).
